quick_wits.name: Quick Wits
quick_wits.description: Once per combat, discard a card to draw a card. Costs no play or Time.

measured_breath.name: Measured Breath
measured_breath.description: End your turn with an unused play to bank it for your next turn. One banked play maximum.

ghost_stride.name: Ghost Stride
ghost_stride.description: Once per combat, you may use a card's basic Move as Blink 2.

discerning_eye.name: Discerning Eye
discerning_eye.description: Once between bosses, replace every card in a combat reward.

rehearsed_escape.name: Rehearsed Escape
rehearsed_escape.description: Once per combat, arm to discard your next non-item Burn card instead of burning it.

makeshift_tool.name: Makeshift Tool
makeshift_tool.description: Once per combat, arm to discard your next item used as a basic Attack or Move instead of consuming it.

carry_the_guard.name: Carry the Guard
carry_the_guard.description: Once per combat, while you have block, arm during your turn to convert all block remaining at turn end into stoneskin.

pain_remembers.name: Pain Remembers
pain_remembers.description: After you first lose health each combat, the next non-item card discarded while your hand has room returns to it.

sure_footed.name: Sure-Footed
sure_footed.description: Once per combat, the first trap blast that would affect you leaves you untouched and resolves normally against everything else.

afterimage.name: Afterimage
afterimage.description: Your first Blink each combat leaves a 2-health illusion behind. You may move through your illusions; ending on one dispels it.

deferred_choice.name: Deferred Choice
deferred_choice.description: Skip a card reward to save one offered card. It replaces one card in your next reward.

salvager.name: Salvager
salvager.description: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.

borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
borrowed_time.description: The first card paid for with a banked play each combat adds no Time.

last_reserve.name: Last Reserve
last_reserve.description: Once per combat, lethal Fatigue leaves you at 1 health.

plunderers_step.name: Plunderer's Step
plunderers_step.description: The first Move or Blink to collect loot each combat refunds its play.

prismatic_instinct.name: Prismatic Instinct
prismatic_instinct.description: Once per combat, name a card with an intensity condition in hand. The next printed play of any copy satisfies all its intensity conditions. Basic Attack, Move, and Blink uses do not consume the effect.

curators_patience.name: Curator's Patience
curators_patience.description: After choosing a relic, save one unchosen relic for your next relic offer.

living_shadow.name: Living Shadow
living_shadow.description: Once between your turns, when an illusion is destroyed or dispelled, return your most recently discarded non-item card to hand—or put it atop your draw pile if your hand is full.

true_bearing.name: True Bearing
true_bearing.description: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within 2 tiles of the entrance.

layaway.name: Layaway
layaway.description: Once between bosses, hold one offer for the next merchant of that type. A pending hold blocks future uses until it returns.

encore.name: Encore
encore.description: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no play or Time.

open_arsenal.name: Open Arsenal
open_arsenal.description: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot, ignoring its normal slot.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.description: Intensity conditions use your highest intensity, regardless of element. A draw enabled solely by Confluence stops before it would trigger Fatigue.

last_door.name: Last Door
last_door.description: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at 1 health. Spent items stay spent.

long_dawn.name: Long Dawn
long_dawn.description: Temporary Light, Vision, and Truesight you create last 1 additional turn. Permanent and tethered effects are unchanged.

sunpath.name: Sunpath
sunpath.description: The first Move or Blink of 3+ tiles each turn leaves radius-1 Light for 2 turns on every tile entered. Blink lights its origin and destination.

witchlight.name: Witchlight
witchlight.description: Living illusions carry tethered radius-1 Light.

dawnbrand.name: Dawnbrand
dawnbrand.description: The first direct attack each turn against an enemy standing in Light inflicts 1 Expose.

afterglow.name: Afterglow
afterglow.description: When an illusion is removed during combat, it leaves radius-1 Light for 2 turns at its final tile.

open_sky.name: Open Sky
open_sky.description: While you stand in Light, you have Truesight.
